Our Journey

The Path Where Two Hearts Unite

28 May 2018

How We Met

Chris was a guest speaker at a youth event at Maleber Baptist Church, where Riri was one of the participants.

29 May 2022

First Date

Four years later, after life had taken us on separate journeys, we met again.

1 October 2022

Officially Boyfriend & Girlfriend

We chose to walk together, through every joy and every storm that came our way.

20 January 2026

The Proposal

On Riri's birthday, Chris asked the question that would change our lives forever.

18 July 2026

Two Families, One Story

Our families finally came together across different cities, with a little help from Zoom.

11 October 2026

Now & Forever – Our Wedding

After all the moments that brought us here, we're ready for a lifetime together.
